extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: space shuttle orbiter, real size approx. 37 m long, 24 m wingspan, 17 m high on its landing gear
extras.notes: front faces -Y; orbiter only (no external tank/boosters), stands on nose and main landing gear; 6 wheels are separate objects (space-shuttle_wheel_*) with origin on the axle, roll around local X; main engine interiors glow cyan (emissive); real inset panel seams, heat-tile grid on the belly, payload bay door seams, elevon and rudder hinge lines; no text, no flags, no agency logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
